messages:
Anika Patel: FYI I ran a quick bring-up for Zephyr-40B across regions (us-east, eu-west, apac-north). Quant profiles: fp16 / bf16 / int8 / fp8. Raw results linked: https://redwood.internal/bench/zeph40b-march.

Dmitri Ivanov: nice. Any obvious regressions on int8 vs fp16?

Anika Patel: int8 shows ~4.2% EM drop on long-context QA (padded length 2048) in eu-west, but us-east is only ~1.1%. Throughput boosts are 1.9-2.3x on H100.

Samir Chen: could be kernel fallback — eu-west H100 nodes still on driver 545. Upgrade to 560 fixed similar before. Can you paste the perf snippet?

Anika Patel: perf-bot posted runs: 
```
model: zephyr-40b
gpu: h100-a100 (mixed)
profile: int8-fp8-fp16
batch: 1, tokens=512
us-east(h100): p50=18ms p90=42ms tps=420 tok/s
eu-west(h100): p50=22ms p90=68ms tps=310 tok/s
apac(h100): p50=24ms p90=75ms tps=290 tok/s
a100-us-east(fp16): p50=29ms p90=85ms tps=240 tok/s
```

perf-bot: Automated note: int8 conversion used symmetric 8-bit per-tensor quant for linear layers; calibration set=1000 samples; kernel chooser=auto

Dmitri Ivanov: hmm p90 jump in eu-west suggests kernel fallback to slow int8 path or missing fp8 kernels. Check compile logs for `nvrtc` fallback.

Lisa Gomez: Also confirm KV-cache warmup used. I saw worse quality on long prefix when warmup not enabled for int8 in older runtimes.

Samir Chen: Re-run suggestion:
```
./tools/qbench --model zephyr-40b --gpu h100 --quant int8 --calib 1000 --warmup-kv --batch 1 --trace-kernels
```
Include `--force-kernel=optimized` to bias to newer kernels.

Anika Patel: Will re-run tonight across all zones with driver 560 and warmup. Adding per-layer scale profiling too. I'll post updated table tomorrow.

Dmitri Ivanov: cheers — if eu-west persists, let's try fp8 hybrid (attn int8, ffn fp16) to tradeoff.

Lisa Gomez: FYI rolling canary to dedicated pool blocked until we confirm quality <1% regressions per eval suite.

Anika Patel: acknowledged. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
